# OOMPF Documentation

Reference pages for sharing, inspecting, and installing native OMP profiles through OOMPF.

## Concepts
- [What is OOMPF](https://oompf.run/docs/what-is-oompf.md): OOMPF's authority boundary and canonical source model.
- [Profile format](https://oompf.run/docs/profile-format.md): Native OMP YAML and the optional `oompf:` metadata block.
- [Models and providers](https://oompf.run/docs/models-and-providers.md): Friendly names, exact selectors, aliases, and verified links.

## Workflow
- [Publishing a profile](https://oompf.run/docs/publishing-a-profile.md): Publish, register, inspect, search, and install.
- [CLI reference](https://oompf.run/docs/cli-reference.md): Commands and machine-readable output.
- [Provenance and revisions](https://oompf.run/docs/provenance-and-revisions.md): Revisions, hashes, canonical sources, and reproducibility.

## Contracts
- [OpenAPI](https://oompf.run/openapi.json): Machine-readable API contract.
